description: This file contains utility functions and mocks related to overflow handling and attempt results in an embedded run context, including error creation, success result creation, and mock functions for testing overflow retries and oversized tool output handling.

methods.name: makeOverflowError
methods.description: Creates an Error object with a default or custom overflow message.

methods.name: makeCompactionSuccess
methods.description: Constructs a success result object for session compaction with optional parameters.

methods.name: makeAttemptResult
methods.description: Generates a default or overridden EmbeddedRunAttemptResult object for testing.

methods.name: mockOverflowRetrySuccess
methods.description: Mocks the behavior of an overflow retry process, simulating an overflow error followed by a successful attempt and compaction.

methods.name: queueOverflowAttemptWithOversizedToolOutput
methods.description: Mocks an attempt with oversized tool output, returning an overflow error.
